description_en: Queries access points of CPFS for Lingjun
description_zh: 查询 CPFS 智算版 AccessPoint
kebab_example: aliyun nas describe-cpfs-access-points --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --file-system-id bmcpfs-290rg9crq96m362ups2 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeCpfsAccessPoints

parameters.help_en:
The file system ID.

CPFS: The ID must start with `cpfs-`, such as cpfs-099394bd928c****.

CPFS for Lingjun: The ID must start with `bmcpfs-`, such as bmcpfs-290w65p03ok64ya****
parameters.help_zh:
文件系统ID。

CPFS：必须以`cpfs-`开头，例如cpfs-099394bd928c****。

CPFS智算版：必须以`bmcpfs-`开头，例如bmcpfs-290w65p03ok64ya****
parameters.name: file_system_id

parameters.help_en:
The number of results per query.
Valid values: 1 to 100.
Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
每次查询结果的个数。
取值范围：1~100。
默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number of the list
parameters.name: page_number

ARN.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) of the access point

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the access point was created. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in UTC. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
CreateTime.description_zh: 接入点的创建时间。按照 ISO 8601 标准表示，并使用 UTC 时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ

Description.description_en: The description of the access point

ModifyTime.description_en: The time when the access point was last modified. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in UTC. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
ModifyTime.description_zh: 接入点的修改时间 。按照 ISO 8601 标准表示，并使用 UTC 时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ

RootPathStatus.description_en:
The current status of the root directory.

Valid values:

Unknown: The root path status is unknown.
NotExist: The root path does not exist. It may have been deleted by the user.
Ready: The root path status is normal
RootPathStatus.description_zh:
当前根目录状态。

包括：

Unknown：rootpath状态未知
NotExist：rootpath不存在（可能被用户删除了）
Ready：rootpath状态正常

Status.description_en:
The current status of the access point.

Valid values:

Active: available
Inactive: unavailable
Pending: being created
Deleting: being deleted

The file system can be mounted only when the status is Active
Status.description_zh:
当前接入点状态。

包括：

Active：可用
Inactive：不可用
Pending：创建中
Deleting：删除中

当状态为Active时才可以挂载文件系统

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the list

PageSize.description_en:
The number of results per page.
Valid values: 1 to 100.                              
Default value: 10
PageSize.description_zh:
每页查询结果的个数。
取值范围：1~100。                              
默认值：10

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of access points
